info.title: recipes API
info.description: API specification for the recipes service

get.summary: List recipes in a collection. Auth required; caller must be at least viewer on the collection.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Id of the collection to list recipes from.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: List archived recipes instead of active ones.

200.description: Recipes in the collection, with their current versions and files, so list pages can render cards (key ingredients, first image) and search ingredients in one request.

currentVersions.description: Current version of each recipe in `recipes` (match on recipeId).

files.description: Files for every recipe in `recipes` (match on recipeId); empty array when none.

401.description: Unauthorized - collection listing requires authentication.

403.description: Forbidden - not a member of the collection or insufficient role.

get.summary: List collections the current user is a member of (any role). Returns only collections where the user's email is in collection_member and (email is validated OR user is creator). Includes menus for each collection (viewers see public menus only; editors/owners see all).

get.summary: List menus in a collection. Auth required; caller must be at least viewer on the collection.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Id of the collection to list menus from.

401.description: Unauthorized - collection listing requires authentication.

403.description: Forbidden - not a member of the collection or insufficient role (at least viewer required).

post.summary: Create menu in a collection. Editor or owner on collection only. Recipe ids in groupings must belong to the same collection.

collectionId.description: Id of the collection this menu belongs to.

400.description: Bad request - e.g. recipeIds in groupings do not belong to the same collection.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid auth headers, or not logged in.

403.description: Forbidden - caller must be editor or owner on the collection.

404.description: Not found - collection does not exist.

get.summary: Get one menu with groupings, plus every recipe in the menu with its current version and files. Auth required; caller must be at least viewer on the menu's collection. Query collectionId is required.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Id of the collection (required for access).

200.description: Menu with groupings, and its recipes' current versions and files, enough to render the menu in one request.

recipes.description: Full Recipe objects for every recipe referenced in the menu's groupings.

currentVersions.description: Current version of each recipe in `recipes` (match on recipeId).

files.description: Files for every recipe in `recipes` (match on recipeId); empty array when none.

401.description: Unauthorized - authentication required.

403.description: Forbidden - not a member of the collection or insufficient role.

404.description: Not found - menu does not exist.

put.summary: Update menu name and groupings. On edit, server appends current user id to editedByUserIds if not present. Editor or owner on collection; menu must belong to collection. Recipe ids in groupings must belong to the same collection.

collectionId.description: Id of the collection this menu belongs to.

400.description: Bad request - e.g. recipeIds in groupings do not belong to the same collection.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid auth headers, or not logged in.

403.description: Forbidden - caller must be editor or owner on the collection; menu must belong to collection.

404.description: Not found - menu or collection does not exist.

delete.summary: Delete menu. Query collectionId when not inferred from path. Editor or owner on collection; menu must belong to collection.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Id of the collection (when not inferred from path).

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid auth headers, or not logged in.

403.description: Forbidden - caller must be editor or owner on the collection; menu must belong to collection.

404.description: Not found - menu or collection does not exist.

get.summary: Load a menu for the public share page by id (no auth).
get.description: Returns the menu, every recipe in its groupings, those recipes' current versions, and their files, so the public share page can render both the menu and diner layouts in one request. Each file's downloadUrl is set by the handler to the shared recipe blob path (/recipes/{recipeId}/shared/files/{fileId}/blob), not the authenticated blob path. Groupings only list recipes that still exist.

200.description: Menu with its recipes, their current versions, and files for the public share page.

recipes.description: Every recipe referenced in the menu's groupings.

currentVersions.description: Current version of each recipe in `recipes` (match on recipeId).

files.description: Files for every recipe in `recipes` (match on recipeId); empty array when none. downloadUrl points at the shared recipe blob path.

404.description: Not Found - no menu with that id.

get.summary: Load a recipe for the public share page by id (no auth).
get.description: Returns the recipe, its current version, and file metadata for the unauthenticated share page. Each file's downloadUrl is set by the handler to the shared blob path (/recipes/{id}/shared/files/{fileId}/blob), not the authenticated blob path.

200.description: Recipe, current version, and files for the public share page.

files.description: Always present; empty array when the recipe has no files. downloadUrl points at the shared blob path.

404.description: Not Found - no recipe with that id.

get.summary: Serve recipe file binary for the public share page (no auth).
get.description: Public binary download for images and other attachments shown on the unauthenticated share page. Distinct from the authenticated GET /recipes/{id}/files/{fileId}/blob so the public surface stays explicit.

302.description: Redirect to the Unsplash hotlink, for files sourced from Unsplash (they are not stored).

404.description: Not Found - recipe or file missing, or file does not belong to that recipe.

session.name: ory_kratos_session
session.description: Signed-in SAF user (Kratos browser session; internal job calls present the same identity via a signed assertion, which is not modeled here). Scopes: `email-verified`, `mfa`, `site-admin` (implies email-verified + mfa).

subtitle.description: Subtitle shown on menus and list views

description.description: Optional longer description shown on recipe detail (not on menu)
description.example: A crowd-pleasing recipe that works every time. Best with room-temperature butter.

updatedBy.description: User id of the last updater

updatedAt.description: When the recipe was last updated

archivedAt.description: When the recipe was archived; null or absent when active

currentVersionId.description: Optional id of the current/latest version for display

id.description: Unique identifier for this recipe version

recipeId.description: Id of the recipe this version belongs to

content.description: Version body — structured ingredients and markdown instructions

ingredients.description: List of ingredients; quantity and unit are strings (e.g. "2+1/3", "cups")

quantity.description: Quantity as string to support values like "1/3", "2+1/3"

instructionsMarkdown.example:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Mix dry ingredients...

example.instructionsMarkdown:

2. Mix dry ingredients.

isLatest.description: Whether this version is the current one for the recipe (only one per recipe is true)

createdBy.description: User id of the creator of this version

unsplash-attribution.description: Minimal fields needed to attribute an Unsplash photo: photographer and links with UTM params per Unsplash API requirements. Shown when displaying Unsplash-sourced recipe files (e.g. full-size view).

photographerProfileUrl.description: Unsplash profile URL with UTM params (utm_source, utm_medium=referral)

unsplashSourceUrl.description: Unsplash source link with UTM params for "on Unsplash" attribution

recipe-file-info.description: Metadata for one file attached to a recipe. Uses SAF file metadata (blob_name, file_original_name, mimetype, size, created_at, updated_at).

id.description: Unique identifier for the file record

recipeId.description: Id of the recipe this file is attached to

blobName.description: Storage blob name (Azure) for the file

fileOriginalName.description: Original filename as provided on upload

updatedAt.description: When the file metadata was last updated

downloadUrl.description: Full URL to download or view the file. For uploads, the API blob path (API base + /recipes/:id/files/:fileId/blob). For Unsplash photos, an images.unsplash.com hotlink capped at 1600px wide; clients may override the w/h/fit query params for smaller sizes.

unsplashAttribution.description: When present, the file was sourced from Unsplash; frontend must show attribution (e.g. full-size view). Omitted when file is from upload.

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
message.example: The requested resource could not be found.

content.description: Version body — structured ingredients and markdown instructions

ingredients.description: List of ingredients; quantity and unit are strings (e.g. "2+1/3", "cups")

quantity.description: Quantity as string to support values like "1/3", "2+1/3"

instructionsMarkdown.example:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Mix dry ingredients...

example.instructionsMarkdown:

html-removal.description: Something removed when sanitizing raw HTML in markdown. With only `tag`, the element was removed (its text is usually kept). With `attribute`, only that attribute was removed from the element. HTML comments use the tag `#comment`.

attribute.description: Attribute removed from the element, when only an attribute was removed

unsplash-photo-search-item.description: One photo returned from Unsplash search, enough to show a thumbnail and to request "add from Unsplash" later.

id.description: Unsplash photo id (short id, e.g. from generateShortId)

thumbUrl.description: URL of the thumbnail image for grid display

regularUrl.description: URL of the regular-size image (e.g. for add-from-Unsplash)

downloadLocation.description: Unsplash download tracking URL; required when adding the photo via the API

add-recipe-file-from-unsplash-request.description: Payload to add a recipe file from an Unsplash photo. The backend looks the photo up by id, tracks the download, and stores its hotlink URL (the image itself is not stored, per the Unsplash API guidelines).

unsplashPhotoId.description: Unsplash photo id (short id) of the chosen photo

downloadLocation.description: Ignored; the backend tracks the download by photo id. Accepted so existing clients keep working.

imageUrl.description: Ignored; the backend uses the photo's own URLs. Accepted so existing clients keep working.
